== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[AT-AT: Deployment Platform (Errata)]] (Virtual Block 2 slip 71, printed on an Executor: Comm Station (V) card), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published full card image shows this text; the other versions of the card are [[AT-AT: Deployment Platform]] (original).

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee news post "Some minor errors and clarifications" (28 June 2010; [https://web.archive.org/web/20100714025225/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=244:some-minor-errors-and-clarifications&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=50 Internet Archive]) and [[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]).
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Dark Side: May ▼ Biker Scout Gear here, and while here, once per turn, may ▼ one card (without ability) in its game text. Light Side: Your characters may enter/exit here for 2 Force each. Unless you occupy, AT-AT's immunity to attrition is +1 (or immune to attrition if non-unique).”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card <code>1002_L6101</code> (printed frame, Decipher art <code>4_159</code>, title, lore, icons, set mark) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
